name: paused-destination
story: An operator pauses a firm's email destination. A new matter arrives while it is paused: its delivery is held for the record, and its hand-off goes to the firm's SMS fallback at once. When the operator resumes the destination, the held delivery is sent with the lead's original time and marked late.
proves: docs/lead-delivery/README.md#3-a-leads-journey (planning step 1: paused is held, hand-off to the fallback at once)
docs/lead-delivery/answers.md#speed-window-to-act-fallback-holding (held records sent with the original time, marked late)
today: The lab holds deliveries that were already waiting when a destination is paused, and sends them on resume. But a lead recorded while the destination is paused gets no delivery at all (a missed lead), so the fallback waits a third of the window (20 minutes) instead of going at once; on resume an operator sends the missed leads.

action.why: firm moving to a new inbox
